items.prompt: Create a premium, hyper-realistic high-fashion advertising campaign image using my uploaded female model as the ONLY identity reference for the main female subject. Preserve her exact facial identity and natural appearance — facial structure, skin tone, eyes, eyebrows, nose, lips, jawline, cheekbones, hairstyle, hair texture, and facial proportions. Keep her instantly recognizable. Do not beautify, reshape, feminize, age, de-age, or alter her facial features. Recreate the overall visual concept of the reference image as a luxury contemporary fashion campaign, featuring a striking red monochromatic aesthetic. Main composition Create a sophisticated editorial layout with three photographic panels: * Large upper panel: the female model in a dramatic low-angle fashion pose, looking confidently toward the camera, wearing an elegant flowing deep crimson/red couture dress with sculptural draping and long sleeves. Dynamic fabric folds and movement, powerful fashion-editorial attitude. * Lower-left panel: the same model in a graceful full-body movement pose, with the red dress dramatically flowing through the air, creating elegant fabric motion. * Lower-right panel: the model standing confidently in a sophisticated red fashion outfit, strong posture, cinematic lighting, luxury styling. Use different poses and compositions in each panel while maintaining the exact same model identity. Art direction Bold red-on-red color palette, rich crimson background, vivid scarlet highlights, deep burgundy shadows, glossy fashion-magazine finish, dramatic studio lighting, subtle rim lighting, high contrast, luxurious atmosphere. The overall design should feel like a premium fashion-tech startup campaign / magazine advertisement, modern, sophisticated, minimal, artistic and highly polished. Add tasteful editorial typography integrated into the composition: “SEE WHAT’S COMING” Large central headline: “FRILANZE” Small subtitle beneath: “NOUN: FREELANCE” Bottom headline: “RED AWAKENING” Bottom copy: “Where creativity becomes content.” “Waitlist Now Live!” Typography should be clean, modern, elegant and fashion-editorial, with excellent spacing and hierarchy. Hyper-realistic photography, luxury fashion campaign, cinematic studio lighting, realistic skin texture, natural facial details, premium retouching without changing identity, detailed fabric texture, dramatic flowing fabric, sophisticated composition, Vogue-style editorial photography, high-end commercial advertising, sharp focus, photorealistic, polished art direction. Aspect ratio: 16:9 landscape. No extra people, no distorted hands, no duplicated limbs, no facial changes, no artificial-looking skin, no watermark, no random text, no logo distortion.

items.title: Felted Wool Smartphone Lock Screen Music Player
items.prompt: ### (Smartphone Lock Screen × Felted Wool Music Player) Visual representation of a music player UI displayed on a smartphone lock screen. Screen Composition (Lock Screen Layout) Top: Album Art Display Area A square-like album art display frame, similar to the music player on an iOS / Android lock screen, is placed in the upper center of the lock screen. This album art section is the [Input Image]. The content and style of the replacement image are free (photos, illustrations, cityscapes, characters, etc.). However, the final output will be completely re-rendered in a felted wool/felt embroidery style. - Outlines are slightly blurred - Colors are softly blended - Fiber unevenness is visible The style differences of the original image are not retained; only the texture is completely unified. Center: Music Player UI Below the album art is the music player control area specific to smartphone lock screens. - Song title display - Artist name display - Playback bar (progress) - Play / Pause button - Previous / Next button All are arranged as rounded felt buttons. Bottom: Lock Screen Shortcuts At the bottom of the screen are round shortcut icons, like those on a lock screen. - Flashlight - Camera These are placed on the left and right as fluffy felt icons. Atmosphere, Color, and Light Automatic Color Matching Rule (Important) The main color tone, atmosphere, and brightness of the album art [Input Image] are automatically analyzed and reflected in the overall background color of the screen.
